data.name: Belak
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew roots 'bel' (God) and 'ak' (power), Belak signifies 'God's power'. This name holds a significant connection to the Bible, particularly the Old Testament where God displays His might through various miracles.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's ever-present power and protection.
